LanguageData.OARK_Letter_GravDataBeaconLanded: The Research Department beacon has successfully recorded and transmitted a large amount of reverse-gravity engine landing data, which will significantly advance the Research Department's progress. However, during this transmission process, the massive data stream also created a highly conspicuous signal. Perhaps it's time to prepare for mechanoid attacks.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_EnterCrashedGravship: To assist your data retrieval, Oberonia Aurea Orchid's technical division has remotely locked the ship's database.\nThis will prevent automatic formatting during your hacking attempt, and will help identify the ship's origin as you gain more access privileges.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_NormalPilot: Technical division has identified this wreck's affiliation from your hacked data: a minor space faction. You may proceed without fear of retaliatory attacks.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_NotNormalPilot: Technical division has identified this as a pirate vessel. Database logs indicate a pirate group is already en route.\n\nYou may continue hacking, but this may lead to direct confrontation. Abandoning now will lose all hacking progress.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_BrokenPilotAttack: Technical division reports: vessels matching this ship's signature are approaching - likely pirates coming to salvage. Continued hacking will inevitably provoke conflict.\n\nEstimated arrival: 1 hour.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_BrokenPilotRequest:
Local Oberonia Aurea Orchid court formally requests data access.

They propose using your access privileges to breach the ship's core database for victim identification and pirate base tracking. This will trigger automatic data wipe, but they'll compensate with silver shipments and increased imperial standing.

This optional request carries no penalty for refusal.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_CrashedGravshipFollowUp: Your earlier intelligence enabled joint fleets to destroy a hidden pirate base. Merchant guilds express gratitude, and Imperial opinion of you has further improved.\n\nEven at this distance, the exploding space station creates a spectacular lightshow - arguably the most satisfying fireworks display imaginable.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_BrokenPilotHacked_NoProjectP: Your colonists completed the hack but found no meaningful data.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_BrokenPilotHacked: Your colonists successfully extracted valuable data from the ship's database.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_ScienceDepartmentFriendly:
Your anti-gravity engine data enabled breakthrough research. While many researchers remain absorbed in further study, the department is collectively celebrating.

As key contributors, they've prepared a reward list acknowledging your courage, scientific curiosity, and friendship with the Oberonia Aurea Orchids.

You may request:
LanguageData.OARK_ScienceDepartmentFriendly_I: Advanced training for one of our members
LanguageData.OARK_ScienceDepartmentFriendly_Default: No, scientific dedication can't be priced, and true friendship isn't a calculated transaction
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_GravResearchExchange: The research officer agreed to your request after brief consideration.\n\nIn the communication, he stated that the most effective way to teach knowledge is to teach how to think, therefore he has arranged a comprehensive on-site tour of the Research Department for one of your colonists. When your colonist is ready, they can visit via shuttle, and the Research Department will warmly welcome your colonist.
